# `api.lookup.get_cpacks`

> `GET /lookup/cPacks` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.lookup.get_cpacks() -> list[CPackEntityResult]
```

**CLI**

```bash

```

Discover valid 8_01 packing identifiers from the server.

## Response

Returns a list of `List[CPackEntityResult]`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `Optional[UUID]` | no | Id. |
| `name` | `Optional[str]` | no | Name. |
| `inchesToAdd` | `Optional[float]` | no | Inches to add. |
